notes: 🤖 The bot no longer sleeps through late server decisions. The server’s pick lanes decide after the full market data lands and grades — but the bot asked only once per day, so if it asked before the lanes had run it heard “nothing” and clocked off, missing decisions made later that evening. It now reads the lane’s run stamp in the reply: while the server hasn’t decided TODAY yet, the bot keeps checking every few minutes and places the decisions the moment they exist — and the main screen says exactly that instead of “done for today”. Decisions a closed app misses are still placed as dated orders on the next open, filling honestly from their decision day, as always.
